items: precondition — Input assumption: the array is ordered.
mid — Index of the middle candidate.

blocks.title: Sort before searching
blocks.text: Binary search relies on a sorted array; otherwise discarding half may lose the target.

blocks.title: Inspect the middle
blocks.text: Compare target to the midpoint and keep only the half that could contain it.

blocks.title: Stop correctly
blocks.text: Return an index when found; return -1 if low becomes greater than high.

blocks.text: Use inclusive low and high indexes.
